The growth is driven by strong gains in the Northern California and metro New York/New Jersey, with same-store residential revenue projected to climb 3.0%-7.0% in those regions during the year. Meanwhile, Boston, the Mid-Atlantic, Southern California, Southeast Florida, and the Pacific Northwest are expected to exhibit 1.0%-2.0% growth. Atlanta, North Carolina, Denver, and Texas are expected to be lower performing, with growth of less than 1.0%.
The outlook midpoint of 2% growth is consistent with its previous same-store residential revenue growth guidance provided by Equity Residential and AvalonBay on July 22, 2026. Vivmark
stock rose 0.9% in Wednesday premarket trading.
Rent growth is consistent with Vivmark's
expectations and in line with normal seasonality, it said. As of Sept. 11, 2026, same-store net effective asking rates grew 3.6% Y/Y, while physical occupancy was 95.7%.

title: Vivmark sees FY 2026 residential revenue growth driven by Northern California, metro New York
